source: unit-amplitude x-polarized plane wave propagating along +z
open_boundary: analytic outgoing free-space dyadic Green tensor; no PML
far_field: direct coherent radiating-dipole sum and solid-angle quadrature
limitations: The example validates a complete 3D geometry/source/open-domain/far-field pipeline for DDA. Because radiation is imposed analytically, it does not test PML or a surface-based near-to-far transform; those remain separate method-specific contracts for FEM/FDTD/FIT.
